r3_gaps.finding: Current canonical Project Registry uses ECO for Evolutionary Ecology Research, while R3 candidate p1_programs.ECO and WORLD_ECONOMY/ECO_FUTURE use ECO for physical world economy.
r3_gaps.recommended_resolution: Reserve ECO for Evolutionary Ecology; rename future world economy program/owner token to ECON, matching the later R3 prepromotion control intent that future economy remains ECON.
r3_gaps.required_before: GLOBAL-P0 R3 promotion or any program-ledger canonicalization

r3_gaps.finding: R3 WQ is described as actor-scoped and mandatory consumers list AI/NAV/gameplay, but autonomous ENV/POP/ECO simulation also needs deterministic non-authoritative world projections.
r3_gaps.recommended_resolution: Clarify whether WQ supports system/domain-scoped query principals/plans or whether ECO must consume a canonical ENV projection adapter outside actor-scoped WQ. Do not create ECO-private WQ.

r3_gaps.finding: R3 assigns generic POPULATION_FIELD ownership to POP_FUTURE while evolutionary ecology research already treats population state as ecological truth.
r3_gaps.recommended_resolution: ECO owns ecological population model semantics; POP owns generic production aggregate/runtime field and LIFE integration. Define an adapter boundary, not two population fabrics.

r3_gaps.finding: ENV owns physical environment simulation and MAT owns materials, but the canonical ENV/MAT/WQ -> evolutionary ECO projection contract is not declared.
r3_gaps.recommended_resolution: Add explicit ecology consumer intersection for environmental and substrate projections.

r3_gaps.finding: WB consumers explicitly include POP/ENV but not evolutionary ECO, leaving unclear whether ecology work is budgeted through POP/ENV adapters or as its own domain adapter.
r3_gaps.recommended_resolution: Choose one explicit path while preserving WB ownership and no ECO scheduler.
